focused_prelaunch_watcher.coverage: Started before focused launch and during setup. Samples installed auth and every matching owned temporary home. It completed a global scan after both batches finished.

bounded_retry_watcher.observation_limit: The executed watcher did not log sampled paths. These homes were active at watcher start according to native session manifests and matched its collect glob; this is interval-based evidence, not a per-file observation log.

completion_rescan.scope: Completed Claude post-PR archive only, sampled installed credentials and then-active homes after the post-PR temporary homes were removed.

lost_value_limitation: The failed completion and setup watchers lost their in-memory sets on exit. Global replacement scans found no matches for the credentials they observed, but cannot establish coverage of any temporary-only refreshed value that disappeared before another watcher sampled it. No credential values were printed or persisted.

final_stable_scan.scope: After all native sessions finished; all current published evidence artifacts, using then-observable installed credentials. Does not restore any lost temporary-only value.
